title: Installation of the Main Landing Gear Leg Assembly

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Main Gear — Main Gear Leg Assembly

abstract: Installation of one main landing gear leg assembly on the aircraft, covering the pin fitting sequence, the torque link clearance set by the sliding tube coating standard, and the retraction and brake functional tests.

sections.purpose: This task installs one main landing gear leg assembly on the aircraft, sets the torque link clearance for the sliding tube standard fitted, and verifies the installation by retraction and brake functional tests.
sections.job_setup_note: Check the sliding tube coating standard on the leg data plate before you set the torque link clearance, because the sprayed coating builds up on the running surface and needs a different clamp shim. Do not mix the clamp standard with the coating standard. The leg must be supported by the trolley and the overhead sling together until both pivot pins are fitted and locked.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm from the leg data plate whether the sliding tube carries the plated or the sprayed coating standard. CAUTION: THE TORQUE LINK CLAMP IS DIFFERENT FOR EACH COATING STANDARD. FITTING THE WRONG CLAMP WILL BIND THE TORQUE LINK AT FULL EXTENSION. 2. Position the leg on the trolley under the bay and fit the overhead sling. 3. Raise the leg and align the main pivot bores with the guide pins. 4. Fit the main pivot pins and then the side stay pin in the order given in the referenced data. WARNING: DO NOT PUT ANY PART OF YOUR HAND IN THE PIVOT BORE WHILE THE LEG IS BEING ALIGNED. 5. Lock the pins and confirm the locking with an independent check. 6. Install the clamp D3210114090552 to the standard matching the coating, and the vendor clamp CAD561133-34. 7. Connect the brake pipes and bleed the brake system. 8. Reconnect the sensor of FIN 1545GM, the regulator of FIN 330GB and the pipe of FIN 2002GM. 9. Charge the shock absorber to the pressure and extension given in the servicing chart for the aircraft weight. 10. Remove the trolley and the sling and lower the aircraft onto its wheels. 11. Do the gear retraction test on jacks and the brake functional test, and confirm no leakage at any joint.
sections.close_out: Confirm the pin locking with an independent inspection and record it. Remove the ground locks and the warning notices after the retraction test. Record the leg serial number, the coating standard, the shock absorber charge pressure and the extension against the aircraft, and enter the leg fitment in the component history.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the torque link clamp standard depends on the sliding tube coating

safety_precautions: Keep hands clear of the pivot bore during alignment.
Support the leg with both the trolley and the overhead sling until both pins are locked.
Charge the shock absorber only to the value in the servicing chart.
Have the pin locking independently inspected.
